verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing SaaS, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The agent-pricing doc covers pricing models for customers' AI products, and llms.txt is a docs-discovery file for external tools. Neither is a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
